Register as a driver

Create your driver registration first — the full application opens right after. It takes less than a minute.

  • Keep 80% of every fare — see your share before you accept a trip
  • See the route, load and pay up front on every trip offered
  • Get your own driver login and trip board once you’re approved
  • Free to register — local trips only, Hudson County & North Jersey

Onboarding & background check (one-time, non-refundable): a $49 onboarding fee paid when you join covers your criminal & identity background check — we order it through BackgroundChecks.com (HireRight). You'll also need your NJ driving record (driver history abstract, $15 from NJMVC). Drivers with any New York history may owe extra court-record fees. No driving until you're cleared.

By registering, you confirm the information you give is true and belongs to you. False information or false documents mean permanent disqualification. You authorize GetQuickHaul to run a criminal and identity background check through BackgroundChecks.com (HireRight) and to verify your driving record. The $49 onboarding fee is non-refundable once your check is ordered. No driving until you are cleared and activated. Please allow up to 10 business days after registering for your background check and activation to be completed.

Driver application

Welcome — we’re glad you’re here.

GetQuickHaul is a small, local delivery service based in Weehawken, New Jersey. We help neighbors and local businesses move packages and small loads by cargo van — and drivers like you are the heart of it.

You keep 80% of every fare. That’s the incentive, plain and simple — on every trip, you see the full fare and your share before you decide to take it.

Joining is simple, and you stay in control the whole way. There are just four short stages:

  1. About you — your name and how to reach you.
  2. Your vehicle — what you drive.
  3. Documents — your license, registration and insurance, sent by email.
  4. Review — one last look, then submit.

You’re registered — the application below is the last part. Nothing is sent until you tap Submit on the final screen. If your driver’s license, vehicle registration and proof of insurance are nearby, that helps — but you can start right now and send documents later.

Once you apply, we read everything personally and reach out by phone or email to talk through the next steps. Any work terms are agreed in writing before a first trip — no surprises, and no pressure.

About 3 minutes · You can stop and come back anytime

Become a GetQuickHaul driver.

Drivers keep 80% of every fare. You’ll review every delivery’s route, load and pay before deciding whether to accept it.

Cargo vans · Small trucks · Box trucks Must be 21 or older with a valid license, current registration and appropriate insurance.

How onboarding works

  1. Tell us a little about you and your vehicle.
  2. Send your license, registration, insurance and vehicle photos.
  3. We review everything with you and agree the details in writing before your first trip.
You keep 80% of every fare. Pickup, drop-off, load details, timing and the full fare are shown for each trip before you accept it — your 80% share is right there in the numbers. Registration does not guarantee trips.

Your role as a driver

  • Accept only trips you can complete safely and on time.
  • Keep your documents current and use a safe, roadworthy vehicle.
  • Secure cargo, communicate delays and confirm delivery.
  • Refuse appliances and any illegal, stolen, hazardous, undisclosed or unsafe items.

GetQuickHaul’s role

  • Provide the route, load, timing and the fare — with your 80% share — before a trip is accepted.
  • Coordinate customer communication and service issues.
  • Review required driver and vehicle documents before approval.

Messages with dispatch

Good to know.

What kinds of jobs do you handle?

GetQuickHaul handles packages, boxes and small loads that fit safely in a cargo van.

Do you handle full-house moves?

No. The service is focused on smaller pickup and delivery jobs rather than large moves.

How is my price calculated?

The door-to-door quote is $45 for the first 5 miles, then $3 for each additional mile. Extra stops are $15 each. A $25 NYC toll surcharge applies when the route crosses the Hudson to or from Manhattan. Pickups before 7 AM or after 7 PM have a $15 after-hours surge.

How can I pay?

You can pay three ways: by card or debit card — we send you a secure payment link for your exact trip total before your trip; with Cash App ($GetQuickHaul); or COD (cash or check), collected before unloading. Nothing is due when you book — payment happens once your booking is confirmed.

What items cannot be transported?

GetQuickHaul will not carry appliances; illegal or stolen goods; controlled substances; firearms or ammunition; hazardous, flammable or explosive materials; or anything unsafe to transport. We may inspect or refuse a load.

Can I book from any city?

Yes — enter any address. We pick up in every city where a GetQuickHaul driver is on the road, and the drop-off can be anywhere, priced by driving miles. If the pickup or an extra stop is in an area that isn't open yet, you'll see “No drivers available in this area temporarily” and the booking will not continue — new cities open as drivers register and clear.

About GetQuickHaul

GetQuickHaul — Pickup & Delivery Service in Weehawken, NJ

GetQuickHaul provides fast, careful pickup and delivery for packages, small loads, furniture, and store or warehouse pickups across Weehawken, Hudson County, North Jersey, and the New York City metro area. Book online in minutes and get an instant price before you confirm: $45 covers the first 5 miles, then $3 per mile after that, door to door. Extra stops are $15 each, and deliveries to New York City include a $25 toll surcharge. We are open 7 AM to 7 PM every day; pickups outside those hours carry a $15 after-hours charge for new customers.

What we deliver

  • Package & parcel delivery
  • Furniture pickup & delivery (single items and small loads)
  • Store, warehouse & marketplace pickups
  • Business deliveries on a repeat schedule
  • Driver opportunities — owner-operators earn 80% of every fare

Where we deliver

Weehawken, Union City, West New York, Hoboken, Jersey City, Secaucus, North Bergen, Guttenberg and surrounding Hudson County and North Jersey communities, plus the NYC metro — and more cities opening soon across the country.

Call or text (551) 233-8583 · getquickhaul@gmail.com · Book online at GetQuickHaulNJ.com

Please note: we do not move appliances.
